dictionary.definition: to explain; to loosen; to unfasten, to untie

etymology.hint: To cut 刀 the horns 角 off of an ox 牛; 角 also provides the pronunciation

currentComponents.note: 角 (horn) — 解 pictures removing a part of an animal.
牛 (ox) — together with a knife cutting between horn and ox, 解 pictures separating something into parts, giving its meaning 'to untie' or 'to explain.'

dictionary.definition: knot, tie; to connect, to join

etymology.hint: thread

currentComponents.note: 纟 (thread) — 结 relates to tying or knotting threads together.
吉 (jí) gives a hint of the sound — 结 is pronounced jié, a connection that has shifted over time.

dictionary.definition: to bind, to control, to restrain; bale

etymology.hint: Lumber 木 bound by rope 口

currentComponents.note: 木 (wood) — 束 depicts a bundle of wood.
口 here depicts a rope or band wrapped around the wood, binding it together, giving 束 its meaning 'to bind, a bundle.'

dictionary.definition: fair, equitable; public; duke

etymology.hint: To divide 八 what is private 厶

currentComponents.note: 八 here depicts something splitting apart or being divided.
厶 is an old form meaning 'private' or 'one's own' — 公 shows dividing up private property to share it fairly, giving rise to the meaning 'public' or 'fair.'

dictionary.definition: to take charge of, to control, to manage; officer

etymology.hint: A person speaking orders 口 and raising their arm

currentComponents.note: 司 depicts a person with a raised arm giving orders — an official directing others, giving rise to the meaning 'to manage' or 'to take charge of.'

dictionary.definition: to accomplish; to become; to complete, to finish; to succeed

currentComponents.note: 成 originally pictured a halberd or battle-axe, an instrument linked to conquering or completing a campaign by force. Its meaning shifted over time to the broader sense of 'to become, to complete, to accomplish.'

dictionary.definition: long; perpetual, eternal; forever

currentComponents.note: 永 depicts a river with tributary streams branching off and flowing onward, an image of water extending into the distance without visible end. Because a river's course continues indefinitely, the character came to mean 'long, perpetual, forever' — the sense preserved in 永不 'never' (literally 'forever not').

dictionary.definition: distant, remote, far; profound

etymology.hint: walk

currentComponents.note: 辶 (walking/movement) — relates to 远's meaning 'far, distant,' a long way to walk.
元 (yuán) gives a sound hint — 远 is pronounced yuǎn, sharing the same base sound with a different tone.

dictionary.definition: to help, to assist; to support, to defend; party; gang

etymology.hint: A nation's 邦 flag 巾; 邦 also provides the pronunciation

currentComponents.note: 邦 (a nation/state) — a community bound together
巾 (a flag/cloth) — a banner people rally around to support one another

dictionary.definition: to help, to aid, to assist

etymology.hint: strength

currentComponents.note: 力 (strength) — 助 relates to helping, lending one's strength
且 (qiě) gives a loose sound connection to 助's reading zhù

dictionary.definition: to speak, to say; to scold, to upbraid

etymology.hint: speech

usedInWords.meaning: (after 对/就 + a noun or pronoun) as far as ... is concerned

currentComponents.note: 讠 (speech radical) — shows 说 relates to talking or language
兑 (duì) is the phonetic component; historically 说 was also pronounced closer to 兑's sound before shifting to shuō

dictionary.definition: few, little; less; inadequate

etymology.hint: Grains of sand; 小 provides the pronunciation and meaning

usedInWords.meaning: junior ranking officer in Chinese army

currentComponents.note: 少 depicts a few small dots or grains, like scattered sand — a simple picture of a small quantity, giving the meaning 'few' or 'little.'

dictionary.definition: it; other
certain, sure; definite, exact; real, true

etymology.hint: stone

currentComponents.note: 石 (stone) — 确 originally meant firm and solid like stone, extending to 'true, accurate, indeed.'
角 (jiǎo) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from què.

dictionary.definition: clean, pure; clear, distinct; peaceful

etymology.hint: water

currentComponents.note: 氵 (water) — relates to 清's meaning 'clear (water), pure.'
青 (qīng) gives the sound — 清 is also pronounced qīng, an exact match.

dictionary.definition: clear, distinct; pain, suffering; surname
peaceful, tranquil, quiet

etymology.hint: A woman 女 safe in a house 宀

currentComponents.note: 宀 (a roof, house) — 安 pictures shelter.
女 (woman) — a woman safely inside a house gave 安 its meaning 'peace' or 'safety.'

dictionary.definition: desire, wish; honest, virtuous; ready, willing

etymology.hint: heart

currentComponents.note: 心 (heart) — 愿 relates to a heartfelt wish or desire
原 (yuán) gives a loose sound connection to 愿's reading yuàn

dictionary.definition: to row or paddle a boat; to scratch; to plan; profitable

currentComponents.note: 刂 (a knife) — 划 relates to cutting or marking off dividing lines, and by extension 'to plan, to delimit.'
戋 (jiān) supplies an ancient sound echo for huà, though the connection has faded considerably with time.

dictionary.definition: she, her

etymology.hint: A woman 女 beside you 也

currentComponents.note: 女 (woman) — marks this pronoun as specifically feminine.
也 was already used as a gender-neutral third-person pronoun; adding 女 to it created a new character specifically for 'she.'

dictionary.definition: to talk, to chat; conversation; surname

etymology.hint: speech

currentComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 谈 relates to talking, conversation
炎 (yán) gives a sound close to 谈's reading tán

dictionary.definition: to shine, to reflect, to illuminate

etymology.hint: fire

currentComponents.note: 灬 (fire) — relates to 照's meaning 'to shine, illuminate; photograph.'
昭 (zhāo) gives a sound hint — 照 is pronounced zhào, sharing the same base sound with a different tone.

dictionary.definition: slice, splinter; page, strip

etymology.hint: Half of a tree trunk; compare 爿

currentComponents.note: A pictograph of half of a split tree trunk, shown in cross-section (compare 爿, the other half) — the source of 片's meaning 'a thin slice, piece.'

dictionary.definition: each, every

currentComponents.note: 母 (mǔ, 'mother') serves as the phonetic base; the sound has since diverged from měi, so the connection is mostly historical today.

dictionary.definition: to welcome, to receive, to greet

etymology.hint: walk

currentComponents.note: 辶 (to walk) — 迎 describes walking out to meet and welcome someone.
卬 (áng) gives a sound distantly related to yíng, having drifted apart over time.

dictionary.definition: elder brother

etymology.hint: Older brother 儿 speaking 口 to younger ones

currentComponents.note: 口 (mouth) pictures someone speaking.
儿 (person) below gives the shape of a person, together showing an elder brother speaking to his siblings.

dictionary.definition: young brother, junior

currentComponents.note: Ancient forms show a stake wound with cord in a spiraling, ordered pattern — a symbol of sequence and rank among siblings that gave 弟 its meaning 'younger brother.'

dictionary.definition: from, by, since, whence, through

etymology.hint: One person 人 following another

currentComponents.note: 人 (person), doubled — one person shown following another depicts the idea of accompanying or coming from somewhere.

dictionary.definition: to gather, to collect; overall, altogether

etymology.hint: Many mouths 口 speaking with one mind 心

currentComponents.note: 口 (mouths) — 总 pictures many voices.
心 (heart, mind) — many mouths brought together under one mind gave 总 its meaning 'overall' or 'to gather together.'

dictionary.definition: to bow, to salute; to worship, to pay respects

etymology.hint: Two hands 手 put together in respect

usedInWords.meaning: to request sb to do sth

currentComponents.note: 手 (hand), shown twice, side by side — two hands pressed together in a gesture of respect, giving 拜 its meaning 'to bow, to pay respects.'

dictionary.definition: to raise, to support; to entrust, to rely on

etymology.hint: Using one's hands 扌 for support 乇; 乇 also provides the pronunciation

usedInWords.meaning: to request sb to do sth

currentComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — a hand held out, palm up
乇 — something resting on the upturned palm for support

dictionary.definition: elder sister; miss, young lady

etymology.hint: woman

currentComponents.note: 女 (woman) — 姐 names a female relative, an older sister.
且 (qiě) gives the rhyme, close to jiě though the tone differs.

dictionary.definition: news, rumors; to die out, to melt away, to vanish

etymology.hint: water

currentComponents.note: 氵 (water) — relates to 消's meaning 'to disappear, dissolve,' like something dissolving in water.
肖 (xiào) gives a sound hint — 消 is pronounced xiāo, sharing the same base sound with a different tone.

dictionary.definition: to end, to cease, to put a stop to; pause, breath, rest; news

etymology.hint: To breathe (life, 心) through one's nose 自; 心 also provides the pronunciation

currentComponents.note: 自 (nose) — the breath passing through.
心 (heart) — the breath of life, giving 息 its meaning 'to breathe; to rest; news.'

dictionary.definition: this, these; in this case, then

etymology.hint: sitting man

currentComponents.note: 匕 here relates to a person crouching or sitting — 此 originally pictured 'this place' where someone is.
止 (zhǐ) gives a hint of the sound — 此 is pronounced cǐ, sharing a similar final though the initial has shifted over time.

dictionary.definition: no, not; lacking, -less

currentComponents.note: 无 (a simplified form of 無) originally depicted a person holding ornamented sleeves or plumes while dancing; the character was borrowed for its sound to mean 'nothing, without,' and the dance meaning was later given its own character, 舞.

dictionary.definition: law, rule, statute; method, way; French

etymology.hint: The course 去 followed by a stream 氵

currentComponents.note: 氵 (water/stream) — water naturally follows a fixed course, an image linked to the idea of 'law' or 'method.'
去 (to go/a course) — the path a stream follows suggested a regulated, consistent way of doing things, hence 'law, method.'

dictionary.definition: building, house, room

etymology.hint: door

usedInWords.meaning: rent for a room or house

currentComponents.note: 户 (door) — 房 relates to a room or house, a space behind a door
方 (fāng) gives the sound — 房 is pronounced fáng, a close match

dictionary.definition: cloth; clothes, apparel; dress, coat

etymology.hint: A woman's dress

currentComponents.note: A drawing of a robe's collar and folded sides, seen from the front.

dictionary.definition: clothes; to dress, to wear; to take medicine

etymology.hint: A person 卩 putting on 又 a coat 月

currentComponents.note: 卩 (a person) — the one being dressed.
月 (a garment shape) — a hand 又 placing a coat on the person, giving 服 its meaning 'clothes; to obey, submit.'

dictionary.definition: to hear, to listen; to understand; to obey

etymology.hint: Words 口 reaching an ear 斤

currentComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — words spoken by a mouth are what reach the ear, giving 听 its meaning 'to listen.'
斤 stands in for the ear in this simplified character — the target that spoken words reach.

dictionary.definition: to take part in, to intervene; ginseng

usedInWords.meaning: to visit (a place, e.g. museum or factory)

currentComponents.note: 彡 (shān) is the historical phonetic component of 参; sound change over time has left little resemblance to the modern reading cān

dictionary.definition: to add to, to increase, to augment

etymology.hint: Supporting a cause with the strength 力 of one's words 口

currentComponents.note: 力 (strength) — 加 pictures adding one's effort to a cause.
口 (mouth, words) — combining strength with words of support gave 加 its meaning 'to add' or 'to increase.'

dictionary.definition: to set up; to manage, to run; to deal with, to handle

etymology.hint: strength

currentComponents.note: 力 (strength) — relates to 办's meaning 'to handle, manage, do,' something accomplished through effort.
八 (bā) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from bàn.

dictionary.definition: only; sole
dead; death; impassable, inflexible

etymology.hint: A person kneeling 匕 before a corpse 歹

currentComponents.note: 匕 (a kneeling person) — a mourner bowed down in grief.
歹 (skeletal remains) — the corpse being mourned, the source of 死's meaning 'to die, dead.'

dictionary.definition: to select, to elect, to choose; election

etymology.hint: walk

usedInWords.meaning: to take part in an election

currentComponents.note: 辶 (to walk/move) — 选 relates to the process of selecting, as if moving through options
先 (xiān) gives a sound close to 选's reading xuǎn

dictionary.definition: to select, to choose

currentComponents.note: 扌 (hand) shows that 择 relates to selecting or picking something out by hand.
睪 (yì) is close in sound to 择's reading zé, and appears as the shared phonetic element across a family of characters that includes 泽, 译, and 驿.

dictionary.definition: source, origin, beginning

etymology.hint: cliff

currentComponents.note: 厂 (a cliff or overhang) — 原 relates to a source high up, such as a spring emerging from rock.
泉 (quán) gives a hint of the sound — 原 is pronounced yuán, a connection that has shifted somewhat.

dictionary.definition: real, true; honest, sincere

currentComponents.note: 实 (simplified from 實) combined 宀 (a roof) with 毌, a string threaded through valuables such as coins or shells — the picture of a house full of stored wealth. That sense of substance and fullness gives 实 its meaning 'real, solid, true, actual.'
